'''InQuest''' was Wizard Press's collectible-card-game magazine. Issue 22 (February 1997) printed [[Michael Mikaelian]]'s special report [[Star Wars World Championships (InQuest)]] on the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="inquest">Michael Mikaelian, "Star Wars World Championships", ''InQuest'' #22 (February 1997), p. 14. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-magazine-issue-22 InQuest Magazine Issue 22], Internet Archive.</ref>

Issue 20 printed Mikaelian's Killer Decks II Yavin 4 Counterstrike deck.<ref name="inquest" /> Issue 38 (June 1998) included a Force Playmat insert.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=185 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 185. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
